turns.content: Now make a pivot sample from the same sales dataset — region and city on rows, department crossed with revenue/cost on columns.

Since the grid core is headless, I'll construct PivotDataViewModelParams directly: distinct (region, city) tuples form the row facet levels, departments crossed with measures form the column facet levels, and a small in-memory aggregation fills the column-major data grid.
Reuse the shaping helper from the flat sample package instead of duplicating the aggregation.

Both samples now share runtime/shaping.ts — rowsToGroupedFlatParams for the flat table and rowsToPivotParams for this pivot. The helpers were hoisted since two samples needed the same aggregation logic.
